researchQuestion: Did selected Q2 and first-half 2025 statement-of-operations values change between the 2025 and 2026 SEC-filed quarterly exhibits?

completenessBoundary.definition: The 17 statement-of-operations rows reported for both the three and six months ended June 30, 2025 in both named SEC-filed exhibits.
exclusions: Per-share and share-count rows not present in the earlier exhibit table

limitations: Nebius is a foreign private issuer. This ledger uses financial statements furnished in Form 6-K exhibits, not domestic Form 10-Q inline XBRL.
Values are matched at the issuer-presented USD-million precision. Zero observed differences does not prove that no lower-precision source-system differences exist.
The scope is the common statement-of-operations table only; it does not claim that every comparative in the full filing package is unchanged.
Discontinued-operations presentation follows the issuer tables and should not be combined mechanically with continuing operations.
SEC acceptance timestamps establish public availability, not investor processing time.
Research and education only; not investment, trading, legal, accounting or tax advice.
